d:
Hi guys, I am the author/creator. I don't have a Patreon or anything. It's the first time I've tried something like this so forgive me if the dialogue or scenes are a bit cringe or whatever. I feel like I improved a lot as I went, I was almost tempted to go back and re-do the first few dozen pages but if I did that I would never finish. If you have any comments or requests or improvements I'm all ears!

I mostly was working on this for my own enjoyment, just messing around but figured I would post it here to see if other people would like it too. I feel like my... uhh... tastes are pretty obvious so if you have the same ones stay tuned. I plan on updating this series with a couple more scenes soon.

Thanks for reading!

EDIT: I made a Patreon, I'm not sure what or when I'm going to post on it but you can follow me there for updates on this comic and future new stuff!

https://www.patreon.com/c/PinataSeal
